summary: Aurora Mobile Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports revenues of RMB93.3 million (US$13.5 million), a 5% year-over-year increase, and net income of RMB1.2 million (US$0.2 million). This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is disclosed. The filing serves to update the market on the company's quarterly performance and is incorporated by reference into previously filed registration statements. There are no deal terms or special-situation mechanics to analyze; the filing is purely a periodic financial report.
